caption: A dimmer knob is turned slowly, and the ceiling lights fade from bright to a dim glow.

sa.check: A dimmer knob is turned slowly.
The ceiling lights fade from bright to a dim glow.
The brightness follows the knob smoothly.

pc.expect: The brightness follows the knob, down when turned down.
pc.fail: The lights stay bright; or brighten as the knob is turned down; or change with the knob still.

pc.expect: The fade is smooth and does not jump or reverse on its own.
pc.fail: It jumps; or flickers; or brightens again with the knob steady.

pc.expect: Nothing else in the room changes brightness.
pc.fail: A lamp elsewhere changes; or daylight changes; or the lit area moves.

pc.expect: The light dims without changing colour.
pc.fail: It turns a different colour; or changes to another kind of light; or the walls change colour.
A light vanishes; or appears; or the knob duplicates.
The furniture rearranges; or the ceiling changes; or the knob changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
